meta.name: ship
meta.description: Prepare or execute an authorized controlled release with verified checks, recovery and an operating owner. Use when a customer increment is ready for deployment.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把已就绪的版本经核对与回滚预案后正式发布上线
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果有一个客户增量已就绪、准备部署
copy.tagline_en: Release a ready increment to production with verified checks and a rollback plan
copy.fit_line_en: For you if a customer increment is ready and waiting to be deployed

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会依据任务上下文契约与方法文档,为一个已授权的受控发布做准备工作或执行发布:处理核对过的检查项、回滚方式和运维责任人,并如实报告缺失的能力或未运行的检查。
howto.when: 当某个客户增量已经可以部署时触发;如果是由 @fde 调用,则沿用其当前的净化数据包与范围,不重新开始发现流程。

say.text: 这个客户增量可以发布了,帮我准备一次受控发布
say.note: 会先读任务上下文契约与方法文档

say.text: 按已确认的检查项和回滚方案执行这次发布
say.note: 执行过程会记录运维责任人

say.text: 发布前帮我列出还没跑过的检查项
say.note: 缺失项会如实报告,不会被略过

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude prepares or runs an authorized controlled release from the task context contract and method: checked items, recovery, and an operating owner, reporting missing capabilities or unrun checks honestly.
howto.when_en: Triggers when a customer increment is ready for deployment; if called by @fde it reuses its current sanitized packet and scope rather than restarting discovery.

say_en.text: This customer increment is ready to deploy — prepare a controlled release.
say_en.note: It reads the task context contract and method first.

say_en.text: Run this release with the confirmed checks and recovery plan.
List the checks that haven't run yet before release.
say_en.note: Missing or unrun checks are reported as-is.
